MIDDLESEX COUNTY
SHERIFF'S SALE
26000028
SUPERIOR COURT
OF NEW JERSEY
CHANCERY DIVISION
MIDDLESEX COUNTY
DOCKET NO. F01122623
WELLS FARGO BANK, N.A., is the
Plaintiff, and LINDA HOFFMAN, ET
ALS., are Defendants, writ of execution for the sale of mortgaged
premises dated 12/10/2025.
By virtue of the above stated Writ,
to me directed and delivered, I will
expose to sale at public vendue on
WEDNESDAY, the 11TH DAY of
MARCH A.D. 2026, at the hour of
one thirty by the then prevailing
(Standard or Daylight Saving) time,
in the afternoon of the said day, at
the Heldrich Hotel, 10 Livingston
Ave. New Brunswick, N.J. 08901.
The property to be sold is located
in the TOWNSHIP OF EDISON,
County of Middlesex, State of New
Jersey.
premises commonly known as: 103
GRACEY ST. EDISON, NJ 08817;
Being Known as: Lot: 19.01; Block:
318 on the official Tax Map of the
TOWNSHIP OF EDISON.
Dimensions: 62FT. X 100FT.
Nearest Cross Street: PLAYER AVE.
The occupancy status of the property is: OCCUPIED by Owner.
Plaintiff’s good faith estimate of its
upset price is $162,800.01.
*Subject to any unpaid taxes,
municipal liens or other charges,
and any such taxes, charges, liens,
insurance premiums or other
advances made by plaintiff prior to
this sale. All interested parties are
to conduct and rely upon their own
independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding
interest remain of record and/or
have priority over the lien being
foreclosed and, if so the current
amount due thereon.
**If the sale is set aside for any
reason, the Purchaser at the sale
shall be entitled only to a return of
the deposit paid. The Purchaser
shall have no further recourse
against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee, or the Mortgagee’s attorney.
THE SHERIFF HEREBY RESERVES
THE RIGHT TO ADJOURN THIS SALE
WITHOUT FURTHER NOTICE
THROUGH PUBLICATION.
SURPLUS MONEY: if after the sale
and satisfaction of the mortgage
debt, including costs and expenses,
there remains any surplus money,
the money will be deposited into
the Superior Court Trust Fund and
any person claiming the surplus, or
any part thereof, may file a motion
pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and
4:57-2 stating the nature and
extent of that person's claim and
asking for an order directing
payment of the surplus money, The
Sheriff or other person conducting
the sale will have information
regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount of the
upset to be satisfied by said sale is
the sum of ONE HUNDRED THIRTY
SIX THOUSAND FIVE HUNDRED
FIFTY SIX DOLLARS AND SEVENTY
FOUR CENTS ($136,556.74)
DOLLARS more or less, plus interest
together with the costs of this
sale. THE UPSET AMOUNT MAY BE
SUBJECT TO FURTHER ORDERS OF
ADDITIONAL SUMS.
The subscriber reserves the right to
adjourn said sale from time to time
subject only to such limitations or
restrictions upon the exercise of
such power as may be specially
provided by law or rules of the
Court, Sold subject to conditions of
sale.
Successful bidder must pay 20% of
bid in certified check or official
bank check at close of sale and the
balance in two weeks.
Mildred S. Scott, Sheriff
BROCK & SCOTT, PLLC
302 FELLOWSHIP ROAD, SUITE 130
MOUNT LAUREL, NJ 08054
Attorneys
